response.sql: SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(b.spent) AS average_spent, AVG(b.remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(b.remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_difference FROM budget AS b WHERE b.link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average remaining is calculated across budget lines, so events with more lines have more weight.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the average of the event averages, giving each event equal weight.
alternatives.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS average_spent, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, average_spent, average_remaining, average_remaining - (SELECT AVG(average_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS remaining_difference FROM event_averages ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
